environment.selection: Top five ranked Tier A/B environments across all four leagues for the Saturday/Sunday weekend.
environment.tier_A: Both teams have at least three current-season matches in the selected history.
environment.tier_B: Both teams have at least one current-season match in the selected history.
environment.tier_C: Informational only; never produces a pick.

three_plus_ranking: previous-five average player share of team shots descending

weekend_board.method: Build a possible-XI board before matchday. A provisional name becomes official only after that same player is confirmed in the home starting XI before kickoff.
weekend_board.replacement_policy: Do not silently replace a failed provisional top-three name with a lower-ranked player after outcomes or kickoff. Fewer than three official picks is acceptable.

integrity: Every historical feature must use records strictly before the fixture cutoff.
Environment snapshots, manifests, frozen boards, official locks and settlements are immutable once written.
Possible lineups and provisional candidates are never counted as official picks.
Missing fields remain missing; never invent shots, minutes or starters.
The 3+ workflow is separate from the frozen 2+ Plan A/Plan B research.
